_about: EV-004 gold cases for citation resolution (REQ-002). Live cases reference real /answer responses in evals/fixtures/exa-live; synthetic cases are labeled.
labelStatus: Assistant-proposed from the citation rule in docs/futari/ARCHITECTURE.md section 'Citations'. Gold once plan kensaku-mvp-v1 is approved.
rule: A marker is '[' n (',' n)* ']' with 1-based integers n. Marker n resolves to citations[n-1].url. An n outside 1..citations.length is removed from the rendered text and counted in unresolvedMarkers. A paragraph (split on blank lines, or the whole text when there are none) with zero resolved markers is flagged uncited. Rendered source links are exactly the resolved citation URLs, de-duplicated in first-use order.
